newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts target 109-30 on the upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts target 109-30 on the upside.

text.p: Technical indicators suggest June gilts have the scope to move above short term trendline resistance at 109-30 on Thursday, analysts said.

"We remain pretty bullish on gilts," said Chase technical analyst Guenter Redeker, adding the market was well underpinned between 109-11 and 109-07. The 109-11 level represents trendline support and 109-07 is the low from April 22.
"That is supporting the wave structure which is bullish, suggesting we should get a move above 109-30, short term trendline resistance from a short term descending channel," said Redeker.
By 0736 GMT, the June gilt was up 4/32 at 109-20.
Redeker said if the market managed to hurdle 109-30 it would have no problem breaking 110-10, the recent high from April 17.
"If we get above here, we could go up to 110-28," he said. "The market needs to exceed that level to confirm 108-05, the low on April 1, as the a major bottom in the market."
Redeker said a move above 110-28 would open up a medium term objective to 112-16, then 113-19, the contract high.
On the downside, a break below 109-07 and a daily close below 109-11 would leave the market very vulnerable, said Redeker.
"In that case we could test 108-24 or even 108-05," he said.
Juliette Clark at the Royal Bank of Scotland said failure to penetrate 109-25 on Wednesday left the market in a vulnerable state and suggested a period of volatile trading was in store.

"A move in either direction is equally plausible in the short term," she said in a research note. "But if June manages to hold above 109-12 and then climbs back through 109-19 the short term view will start to improve."
Clark said Wednesday's high at 109-25 had to be pierced if confidence in the upside was to be restored.
By 0744 GMT June short sterling was unchanged at 93.38.
